purpose: High-recall independent source-discovery enrichment for O3 only; no final strict/sensitivity classification.

methodology.episode_gate: All Group A canonical non-strict episodes with episode_order_distance <= 2 are searched independently; existence of an old historical candidate is never used as a gate.
methodology.location_rule: Retain exact-city Zaporizhzhia separately from oblast/occupied/other-locality mentions. Exact city plus district wording is retained only when the city itself is explicit.
methodology.classification_boundary: These labels are discovery/enrichment labels only. No strict, sensitivity, rejected, or confirmed-miss verdict is assigned.
methodology.deduplication: Multiple articles/messages describing the same potential target episode are retained as raw hits but count once at episode level.

strategy_revision.v1: Generic exact-city/date term search plus repository source inventory.
strategy_revision.observed_failure: Generic search could be dominated by the largest same-day event and did not reliably surface all positive controls.
strategy_revision.v2: Uniform second pass across all O3 dates using exact-city terms plus source-targeted indexed search (Telegram, Suspilne, Ukrinform, Ukrainska Pravda, police/official, and local Zaporizhzhia media).
strategy_revision.control_use_caveat: The v2 refinement was introduced after observing v1 control misses, then rerun globally. Positive controls are therefore calibration controls, not an unbiased held-out estimate of discovery sensitivity.

source_windows.extended_fallback: If primary is empty and same-date relevant reporting has unresolved event time: up to alert_end + 3 h
source_windows.publication_time_rule: Publication time is not treated as event time. If later timing resolution clearly assigns the event outside the target alert, result becomes source_hit_outside_episode_timing.

controls.source: NV live / indexed report of Suspilne message

limitations: No complete raw historical Telegram export for Zaporizhzhia is available in the repository; indexed Telegram/web coverage is incomplete and can disappear or omit older messages.
Search-engine indexing is not a complete census of source publications. no_source_hit_found means no retained hit was found by this pass, not proof that no contemporaneous evidence exists.
A source_hit_exact_city is an enrichment candidate, not evidence that the event occurred inside the target alert. Manual episode attribution is intentionally deferred.

Some retained exact-city hits have coarse event wording (for example, «уночі», «на світанку», «ввечері») or publication immediately after the alert; these are preserved for recall rather than classified.
The positive controls helped calibrate the final v2 strategy; their 4/4 recovery must not be interpreted as an unbiased sensitivity estimate.
No extrapolation from discovery yield to strict-miss rate or denominator-wide miss count is valid.
stop_condition: Source-discovery inventory only. No manual review batch was launched; canonical, historical baseline, monitor, dashboard, Grafana and Netlify were not modified.
